caseStudies.title: A long-lived monolith, modernised in six weeks
caseStudies.problem: A large Rails platform had fallen several major framework and language versions behind, making ongoing development harder and riskier.
caseStudies.approach: I led the work with one other engineer and a fleet of parallel AI coding agents. We split the migration into small, backwards-compatible changes, merged continuously, and used CI to validate each step.
caseStudies.result: Completed the upgrade through several major Rails and Ruby releases in six weeks, then rolled the modernised stack out across production.

caseStudies.title: A slow customer dashboard, reduced from minutes to seconds
caseStudies.problem: A key customer dashboard took minutes to load and sometimes failed, on a codebase with little automated coverage.
caseStudies.approach: I profiled the application, rewrote slow queries, moved heavy panels to asynchronous loading, right-sized the infrastructure, and introduced system tests.
caseStudies.result: Brought load times down to a few seconds, established meaningful automated test coverage, and improved the reliability of core financial workflows.
